thesis: Four live laboratories. One evidence contract: mechanism, attack, oracle, boundary.

labs.name: FAULTLINE
labs.title: Distributed Systems Failure Laboratory
labs.summary: Operate a real five-node Raft + MVCC simulator, inject partitions, replay deterministic failover, and ask the linearizability checker for a witness.

labs.name: SIGNALROOM
labs.title: Autonomy Mission Control
labs.engine: Measured replay from track-fusion, SAR, and VIO
labs.summary: Replay maneuvering targets, sensor dropouts, VIO observability loss, and SAR autofocus boundaries with the published measurements kept visible.

labs.name: MARKETWIRE
labs.title: Exchange and Risk Simulator
labs.engine: Deterministic order-flow and AAD evidence replay
labs.summary: Submit orders, change toxicity, inspect inventory risk, and compare pricing sensitivities without hiding the regime where a strategy loses.

labs.name: KERNELARENA
labs.title: GPU Optimization Laboratory
labs.engine: TensorForge TypeScript IR and generated WGSL
labs.summary: Compare graph shapes, compiler passes, liveness-aware memory plans, generated kernels, and browser-local timing in one inspectable arena.

benchmarks.environment: Apple M2 Pro, 16 GB, in-process simulator
benchmarks.boundary: No sockets, serialization, fsync, scheduling, persistence, snapshots, or membership changes.

benchmarks.boundary: A protocol microbenchmark, not production database throughput.

benchmarks.environment: 5 paired seeds, configured ±6 degree/s model bank
benchmarks.boundary: The bank loses on straight motion and at 12 degree/s.
The repeating path implicitly re-observes landmarks; hover is a documented failure.
Synthetic point targets and time-domain backprojection.
Pathwise AAD returns zero for a sharp digital payoff; smoothing is required.

benchmarks.environment: Apple M2 Pro local run; 26.5 ms AAD vs 1524.5 ms bump-and-revalue
benchmarks.boundary: One workload and machine; not a general performance claim. AAD tape cost was 2.00 times pricing.
The strategy reduced inventory dispersion from 88.1 but also reduced P&L from 20,853 to 15,448.
Browser timing depends on the visitor's GPU and is never presented as a universal speedup.

histories.interpretation: 3.4% lower on the release-candidate rerun; retained as visible variance, not rewritten away.
4.3% lower in the second local run; protocol source is unchanged and machine noise remains plausible.
1.3% growth buys the live cross-shape KERNELARENA matrix; tracked as an explicit bundle cost.

papers.title: Consensus Under Partition: What the Animation Must Not Hide
papers.dek: A visual failure laboratory is useful only when message loss, quorum boundaries, and simulator limits remain inspectable.

papers.title: When Sensor Fusion Loses
papers.dek: IMM, JPDA, VIO, and autofocus each fail for different observability and model-mismatch reasons.

papers.title: Benchmarks That Fight Back
papers.dek: A market simulator, an AAD engine, and a GPU compiler are credible only when the losing regime travels with the headline metric.
